descript.abstract: This dataset represents a bathymetric survey on the Coffeeville Lower Pool of the Black-Warrior River. The Coffeeville Lower Pool is defined as the waters above the confluence of the Black Warrior and Alabama Rivers at River Mile 45.0 extending to the Coffeeville Lock and Dam at River Mile 116.6. This XYZ dataset is a bank to bank survey that is gridded to an 8’ cell and is represented as easting, northing, and elevation respectively. Horizontal Coordinate System: North American Datum of 1983 (NAD83), projected to State Plane Alabama West Zone. Distance units in U.S. Survey Feet. Vertical Datum: Values are based on the North American Vertical Datum of 1988 (NAVD 88). The Z-value represents the river bottom elevation at that particular X,Y point. Water depths can be obtained by subtracting the Z-value from the normal pool elevation value. The normal pool elevation for the Coffeeville Lower Pool is 0.0’. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers maintains a 9 foot channel depth throughout the Coffeeville Lower Pool.
